countries.reasoning: Based on US and global chemical production data up to 2023, the US is a leading ethylene glycol producer with stable production from multiple large petrochemical complexes; data from USGS and industry reports are reliable.

China dominates ethylene glycol production globally due to vast petrochemical capacity and integrated production facilities; data from Chinese industrial surveys and international trade statistics confirm production scale with high confidence.

South Korea is a major ethylene glycol producer with several large petrochemical companies; data from Korean chemical industry reports and trade data are robust but slightly less comprehensive than US and China.

Saudi Arabia has been expanding its petrochemical capacity including ethylene glycol production; data from Saudi energy ministry and petrochemical companies are consistent but some recent expansions may have slight reporting delays.

India is an emerging ethylene glycol producer with growing petrochemical infrastructure; data from Indian industrial reports are less detailed and production estimates vary, leading to moderate confidence.
